name: Titanium Monitor
notes:
- Interface language in Settings: General > Language, with "Same as the Mac", "English" and "Italiano". It is the same choice as System Settings > Language & Region > Applications, and it applies after a relaunch: the pane offers "Relaunch Now".
- The popover shows the startup disk: how full it is, a level bar, the space used out of the total and the space available. It turns orange, "Almost full", at the same threshold as the Overview warning; a click opens the Storage section.
- The popover opens at its full height and keeps it, whatever the metric, instead of growing under the pointer as the first figures arrive.
